quickGuide.title: TCG Administration Quick Guide
quickGuide.subtitle: Learn how to use the synchronization and pricing features
quickGuide.step1Desc: Go to the "Sync" section and select the set (e.g., Origins). The system will connect to Riftcodex and automatically assign the TCGPlayer ID to each card. This is vital for pricing to work.
quickGuide.step2Desc: In the main Products panel, use the "Update Prices" button. The system will use the JustTCG API to look up the exact price by ID. Note there is an 8s delay between requests to respect API rate limits.
quickGuide.step3Desc: Every time you sync a set, the system ensures Normal and Foil (NM English) slots exist for all cards. If a price arrives as Foil, it will always have a slot to be stored in.
quickGuide.proTip: Pro Tip: If you see a card priced at $0, make sure you have run the set synchronization recently to migrate its IDs.
